none: PAS CAM-6B3117: Roman Coin : A Copper-alloy Radiate of Victorinus, AD269-271
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Radiate of Victorinus, AD269-271 (Reece period 13). Reverse legend reads INVICTUS. Reverse shows Sol standing left, holding whip. Gaul mint I. See Reference Cunetio, p 149, c.f. 2534. Obverse legend reads [...]. Obverse shows Radiate bust right. Reverse fields and exergue reads: (*?)//- .Condition is Fine. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 1.96g, diameter is 19.55mm
